end.summary: Defined physical change as no new substance, with changes in shape, size, or state.
end.parentNote: They identified that dissolved sugar is still present and later recognised that physical changes need not always be reversible; this corrected an earlier mix-up. At home, ask Ananya to sort examples into physical or chemical changes and explain whether a new substance forms.
